topic: Rent-to-own furniture trap vs buying outright (Shane vs Lorna)

scenes.narration: A six hundred dollar couch cost one shopper over two thousand through rent to own. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom beside a couch with a price tag flipping from SIX HUNDRED to TWO THOUSAND, comic burst banner reads RENT TO OWN, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Shane and Lorna both want the same couch for their new apartments.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man shane and woman lorna admiring the same couch in a furniture store, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: A rent to own store offers it for easy weekly payments.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a storefront sign labeled RENT TO OWN, a couch with a tag reading ONLY TWENTY A WEEK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lorna signs the rent to own deal for low weekly payments.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lorna signing a contract labeled RENT TO OWN AGREEMENT, a couch behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She never reads that payments total triple the sticker price.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a contract with hidden fine print stamped TRIPLE THE PRICE, woman lorna not noticing it, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Shane skips the store and saves up for a few weeks.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man shane dropping cash into a jar labeled COUCH FUND, a small calendar showing weeks passing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He finds a nearly new couch secondhand for half the price.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man shane beside a clean used couch with a tag reading HALF PRICE GENTLY USED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Shane pays cash once and owns the couch free and clear.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man shane handing over cash, a receipt stamped PAID IN FULL, the couch tagged OWNED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lorna pays weekly for two years and the total balloons huge.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman lorna at a wall of crossed off weekly payment slips, a running total stamped TWO THOUSAND PAID, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Miss one payment and they repossess the couch she nearly finished.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, store workers carrying the couch out of woman lorna's apartment, comic banner reads REPOSSESSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Shane still enjoys his couch having paid far less overall.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man shane relaxing happily on his couch, a note beside him reads PAID HALF PRICE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Skip rent to own, save up or buy secondhand outright. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads BUY OUTRIGHT, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
